name: Radha Krishna Mandir
town_description: Pasighat (approx. 28.067 N, 95.327 E) is the headquarters of East Siang district, on the west bank of the Siang river where it enters the Assam plains. It is the oldest town of Arunachal Pradesh, known for the Siang river front, Komlighat, the Pasighat Buddhist Temple, the East Siang District Museum and the Dangaria Baba Shiv Mandir at Ranaghat.

travel.airport: Pasighat Airport, a military airstrip upgraded for civilian use, on the edge of town.
travel.railway: Murkeong Sel is the nearest railhead; the nearest major junctions are in Assam (Tinsukia/Dibrugarh).
travel.road: Pasighat is on NH-13 and is well connected by road to Assam and the rest of Arunachal Pradesh.

visitor_information.best_time: Winter (October to March) is generally the pleasantest season in the Pasighat plains.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not verifiable for this record; town temples typically open at dawn and close in the evening.
